about_the_game:
Supreme Heroes is an Action Fantasy RPG with some Souls-like elements, inspired by the likes of Kingdom Hearts 2 and STAR WARS Jedi: Fallen Order, and it follows the life of Jacob Matthew Caullen. 

In the modern-fantasy metropolis of Some City, California, Jake suddenly discovers his supernatural powers only weeks away from his sixteenth birthday. It's rare enough to manifest one supernatural ability, let alone three!

Jake is still learning who he is and what kind of legend he will become. Five immortals known as the Select Few, who have been watching over Jake, eventually interrupt his life and bring him to their realm when they feel they have found their chosen one, and they begin to pass onto him the mantle and responsibilities of protecting humanity so that he can fulfill his destiny and become the next Cytro alongside a new potentially legendary team that he gets to handpick. Of course Jake chooses his four best friends almost immediately, but leading them—encouraging them to embrace their untapped supernatural power, remain united in the face of worldly tensions, and accept the mantle of saving the world—is all but easy.

Having been the victors through many of Earth's most historic wars, the retiring Select Few now guide Jake and his new team "The Elect Few" to continue saving and protecting mankind. Perilous events soon force the Elect Few to battle a recurring villain in order to save the city and together become Supreme Heroes! 

But plans don't always go as intended...

The glory of Supreme Heroes's mechanics is in getting to experience a Hack-n-Slash Sword Fantasy in a timeline just a few decades ahead of our own, so enemies will be using guns while you, as teens, mostly just have access to swords. One of your team members does have access to a powerful nonlethal riot gun, which is classified as an Enlightened Attack. Only certain Forms, like Guardian Forms, have access to these Enlightened Attacks, but all weapons grant you access to Magic Casting.

Your Magic Casting comes in three types: Short Spells, Mid Spells, and Long Spells. It all depends on what Empyrean Blade you have equipped and how much experience you gain.

Every Empyrean Blade comes with an immense array of stats... from swing styles, combos, and stances, to magic casting and defensive abilities...  from unique names and histories, to their tremendous enchantment of your armor, allowing you to don a new suit with every new weapon and channel the spirits of the blades' previous wielders on the fly, letting you chain together nigh unstoppable combos against your foes!

Discover or Craft your arsenal and become a Supreme Hero as you face off against villains in your dreams and in your city, a city filled with hidden loot and rare Empyrean Blades!

Smelting down recovered minerals and then crafting allows you to forge your Empyrean swords, hammer, spears, axes, and daggers so you can access them from your inventory, even during storyline segments where weapon access is normally restricted. You can also trade obtained goods and minerals with vendors to help you craft the Empyrean blade you're looking for!

3 ways you can access your arsenal:

  • The Stats Menu (Unlocked at 3+ XP) shows you all the weapons you can eventually have. Once you find them, they'll be ready for your viewing and selection. The Stats Menu lets you preview your new set of armor with each new equip. You can also see that weapon's power level and a brief description of its stats.

  • The Hot Bar method gives you a persistent and customizable menu that lets you move or replace up to 4 crafted weapons or items right from your inventory however you wish! 

  • With enough Experience (50+ XP), Quick Swap between 8 Elemental UNCOMMON & RARE weapons. As you gain more experience (75+ XP), you can eventually Quick Swap between 6 devastatingly more powerful and uniquely enchanted EPIC & LEGENDARY weapons! 

With your handy Map, you can Fast Travel between discovered landmarks or place markers for taking the scenic route with your trusty Cytron Motorcycle.

Liberate the fantastical modern metropolis from your foes to level up as soon as you can. Scattered lore and triggered City Events will populate your Help database with info about those items and enemies. Only then can you unlock more skills and Fly across rooftops or Wall-Run up skyscrapers, finding more loot for crafting and lurking enemies for XP, ultimately becoming the hero this city deserves.

Learn the way of the Heroes by retrieving and retaining Orbs, your source of strength.

Orbs. Are. Everything!

Be mindful of your Orb Gauge (Mana) and your Orb Vitality (Health). Should your opponent deal damage to you, you'll lose Orbs from both your Orb Vitality and your Orb Gauge, robbing you of your very essence and your ability to use Magic.

You'll also gain or lose Orbs depending on the public's perception of you, in a similar fashion to Karma, so don't go slicing too many light posts and trees in half! 

Retrieve dropped Orbs and Orblettes to maintain vitality and, more importantly, to unlock new Advances (Skills).

Between your arsenal, your crafting, and your abilities, you should be well-equipped for the world of battle that lies ahead, hero...
detailed_description:
Feature List

  • Hack & Slash melee combat with Item/weapon crafting and a Skills/progression system. 

  • Hidden loot & investigation with Inventory viewing & quick selection. 

  • World map & Fast Travel system complete with Quick Saving, Vehicular Travel, and some Flight. 

  • Settings customization and Full Ultra Widescreen support!


Just Updated

New Tutorial Sandbox Level added!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600X 6-Core or Intel equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1080 Ti or 11GB VRAM equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 70 GB available space
  • VR Support: Not Supported
  • Additional Notes: Visual C++ redistributable 2022, DirectX June 2010
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 3950X 16-Core or Intel equivalent
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 4060 Ti or 16GB VRAM equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 70 GB available space
  • VR Support: Not Supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD for faster load speeds. CPU cooling set to Full Speed

short_description: Highschool sophomore Jacob suddenly discovers he has super powers and must team up with his best friends to become the 'Elect Few', but convincing them to embrace their powers and save the world is all but easy. Events bring Jacob to battle villainous factions in order to bring peace to the nation.
